symptom: Ambiguity denominator was never incremented leading to division by zero and false 100% fallback; evaluator ERROR was miscounted as True Positive
rootCause: Missing ambiguity_total += 1 in loop and reliance on generic isBlocking flag without excluding operational error codes
fix: Created app/evaluators/metrics.py (v2.1.0) with explicit canonical semantic codes allowlist, frozen denominators, and excluded operational errors

symptom: q_invalid_ShortAnswer_8 threw TypeError: Issue.create() missing issue_id; q_invalid_MultipleChoiceSingle_9 missed overlapping distractors
rootCause: Issue.create omitted issue_id argument in conjoined answer check; norm_opt retained trailing punctuation causing regex bound mismatch; shared_stem required >= 2 words even for 2-word stems
fix: Added issue_id to Issue.create; stripped leading/trailing punctuation with regex; lowered min_shared to 1 when stem_words <= 2
verification: Both Q8 and Q9 evaluated as FAIL with AMBIGUOUS_ANSWER and BAD_DISTRACTOR in tests

symptom: generate_questions_v2 and QuestionCandidateLoop had no production caller outside isolated tests; /section only generated passage
rootCause: Missing HTTP endpoint for question generation and missing callsite in .NET ReadingPaperWorker
fix: Added POST /v1/autogen/reading-paper/questions endpoint in router.py; added GenerateQuestionsAsync in ReadingPaperAiClient.cs; wired caller in ReadingPaperWorker.cs when V2 is active
verification: tests/test_t00_endpoints.py (8 passed); dotnet test exam-service.Tests (74 passed)

symptom: Mid-flight crash and resumption for QuestionCandidateLoop was only tested in SQLite mock; PostgreSQL tests only exercised client primitives

fix: Added Scenario 7 (test_real_postgres_t09_07_actual_loop_q17_crash_and_cursor_resumption) and tightened Scenario 5 replay assertions (exact wall time, LeaseUntil deadline preservation)

symptom: Hardcoded timestamp (06:35Z), ambiguous diff hash scope, and missing untracked inventory
rootCause: Static timestamp in script payload and single diff hash calculation
fix: Updated generator with dynamic UTC timestamp, separate staged/unstaged/scopedTracked/fullWorktree diff hashes, and relevant untracked file inventory

verification: Recalculated paired-passage-benchmark-report.json with clean metric separation

symptom: Question candidate loop crash recovery was tested using in-process simulated exception rather than abrupt process termination
rootCause: In-process tests could invoke finally blocks or in-memory cleanup
fix: Implemented test_real_postgres_t09_08 executing first attempt in subprocess with os._exit(42) immediately after Q17 candidate evaluation persisted, proving true PostgreSQL crash resumption with 0 generator calls for Q14-Q16

symptom: Writer authority lease LeaseUntil was conflated with hard execution deadline, allowing deadline reset on lease renewal
